findings.title: AllowGarbageCollection scope nested inside DisallowGarbageCollection invalidates live String::FlatContent
findings.message: In BUILTIN(Uint8ArrayFromBase64), a DisallowGarbageCollection no_gc scope is created and String::FlatContent input_content is obtained from it (line 502). While this FlatContent is still live, ArrayBufferFromBase64() is called (lines 510-522), which internally creates an AllowGarbageCollection gc scope (line 399) and then calls isolate->factory()->NewJSArrayBufferAndBackingStore() — an operation that can trigger a GC cycle. When GC runs inside the AllowGarbageCollection scope, the heap-allocated input string may be moved or compacted. V8's slow-assert mode tracks a checksum of the string data at FlatContent construction time and re-verifies it at destruction time; after GC moves the string, the checksum no longer matches, causing the CHECK failure: `checksum_ == kChecksumValue`. The root cause is that the AllowGarbageCollection gc scope in the callee is inadvertently nested within the caller's DisallowGarbageCollection no_gc scope, violating the invariant that a String::FlatContent remains valid for its entire lifetime.
findings.suggestion: Move the AllowGarbageCollection scope and all heap allocations (NewJSArrayBufferAndBackingStore) out of the DisallowGarbageCollection scope. Perform all GC-safe string reads first, store results in a temporary buffer, destroy the DisallowGC scope and FlatContent, and only then allocate the JSArrayBuffer and memcpy the decoded data. This is exactly what the fix commit does: ArrayBufferFromBase64 is refactored to return std::unique_ptr<char[]> without any GC allocation, and the JSArrayBuffer allocation is moved to the caller after the DisallowGarbageCollection block closes.

ground_truth.root_cause: The ArrayBufferFromBase64 helper was originally designed to both decode the base64 data AND allocate the output JSArrayBuffer in a single function. To allocate the JSArrayBuffer it needs AllowGarbageCollection, but the caller already holds a DisallowGarbageCollection scope (to safely read the String::FlatContent). Nesting AllowGarbageCollection inside DisallowGarbageCollection is forbidden by V8's invariants: a FlatContent is only guaranteed valid while GC cannot run, and allowing GC to run while the FlatContent is live can move the underlying string, breaking the checksum assertion on FlatContent destruction.
